classes.at_or_above_volume_floor_unscanned: a later bar read for its volume only, at or above that floor
classes.no_later_bar: no later bar read by either source
classes.scanned_not_listed: a follow-up ran the evening's scans on the late bar, every route, and it would not have been listed
classes.under_price_policy: the late bar's close falls under the $3 session-close policy, which keeps it out of every scan
classes.under_volume_floor_unscanned: a later bar read for its volume only, under the floor of the 4%, breakdown and $ scans; the setting-up scans not read
classes.would_have_been_listed: a follow-up ran the evening's scans on the late bar and it would have been listed

rules.missed_sessions: followup.missed_sessions over each name's recorded ending, the night's own sessions_max

sentence: From 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-16 the newest publication of each of 8 nights named 103 stale stock-sessions (58 stocks): 64 were scanned again by a follow-up on their late bar and would not have been listed; 11 fell under the $3 session-close policy; 20 carry a later bar read only for its volume, under the 100,000-share floor of the 4%, breakdown and $ scans (the setting-up scans not read); 8 have no later bar read by either source. No follow-up reading found a late bar that would have been listed (127 readings). Of the 95 later bars, 93 have zero volume and the largest 2,891 shares. Why a bar was absent is not established.
